capabilities: Merge embeds, wikilinks and block anchors into a single LaTeX document
Convert citations, math, admonitions and Mermaid blocks to LaTeX or PNG
Compile the .tex file to PDF, DOCX or Typst with embedded WASM engines
Generate standalone expanded Markdown with all embeds and links resolved
Show a side-by-side interactive PDF preview and archive linked resources
extras: README is written in French. The pandoc.wasm (~59 MB) and typst.wasm (~28 MB) engines are auto-downloaded on first export or fetched manually from settings; an example vault is bundled. The optional native LaTeX PDF path requires TeX Live plus Podman/Docker on PC. Troubleshooting covers missing WASM modules and download failures.
intentEvidence: Pandoc GUI (plugin Obsidian pandoc-gui) fournit une interface de conversion mais requiert toujours Pandoc
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export a note with resolved embeds, wikilinks, block anchors and citations to a compilable LaTeX document without installing Pandoc and a LaTeX toolchain externally.
